title: Anduril product tile
description: A full-bleed media tile with 2px corners and a long eased dark scrim at the bottom, a bold product name and, under it, a tagline with a ↗ arrow. On phones the tagline is always there and decodes as the tile scrolls in; on desktop it opens under the name on hover (the name lifts) and decodes. The tile fades in as it enters the view.
notes: the parent sets the size (e.g. aspect-square, md:aspect-[3/1]); the tile fills it
the label is drawn in the foreground colour over the scrim: best on dark themes or with real photos
needs JavaScript for the tagline decode (hydrate: visible); without it the tagline simply shows
